g.text: NPCI Payment Rail · Autonomous Reconciliation Flow
End-to-End Orchestration: 4 Inbound Settlement Feeds → AI Reconciler → AI Break Investigator → Dual-Track Execution Bots
• Ingests and validates the 4 settlement feeds
• Executes mathematical 4-way join on RRN + UTR
• Reconciles amounts: NPCI == CBS == GL Pool
• Immediately splits flow into two paths:
• Correlates CBS debit logs vs gateway network latency
• Starts real-time RBI T+1 penalty countdown clock
• Auto-posts credit adjustments into Finacle Core Banking
• Resolves RC-91 timeouts without manual human touch
Result: 100% RBI T+1 TAT Compliance (Halts penalty clocks)
Tech: Workbench Cockpit UI + Approval API
• Compiles multi-system evidence dossiers for high-value breaks
• Correlates side-by-side logs for Operations Manager sign-off
Result: Zero unauthorized funds release & strict audit gate
Result: Exactly ₹0.00 variance & instant cycle closure
Finacle Core Banking & SHA-256 MIS Pack
• Direct Reversal API credits customer bank balance
• SHA-256 sealed audit trail for RBI DPSS compliance
The Brain: Ingests 4 feeds, 4-way join on RRN, splits matched vs breaks
The Analyst: Correlates RC-91/96 codes, computes confidence, enforces ₹50k gate
The Speed Executor: Auto-posts Finacle reversals for < ₹50k (halts penalty clock)
The Risk Officer: Compiles dossiers for ≥ ₹50k, 1-click maker-checker sign-off
